title: Learning from Recurrence: Internalizing Depth-Induced Preferences in Looped Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.33468v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A looped language model repeatedly applies the same block to its hidden state before predicting each token. The number of passes is its recurrent depth. Increasing this depth gives the model more computation per token with the same parameters. Can the shared block learn from the predictions it makes at greater depth? Following prior work, we retrofit pretrained OLMo-2-1B with a shared recurrent block and continue mid-training over varying recurrent depths. In the four-pass model, additional passes mainly redistribute probability among tokens that already rank highly after one pass. We use the continuations generated at greater depth to train only the shared block through a single pass, without reference answers or correctness filtering. We call this transfer preference write-back. Write-back further improves one-pass and multi-pass accuracy on most tasks. At their target depths, the updated models outperform a non-recurrent control match

translated_title: 从循环中学习：在循环语言模型中内化深度诱导的偏好
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.33468v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：循环语言模型在预测每个词元之前，会将同一个块重复应用于其隐藏状态，应用的次数称为其循环深度。增加循环深度可以在参数不变的情况下让模型为每个词元进行更多计算。共享块能否从它在更大深度下所做的预测中学习？遵循先前的工作，我们为预训练的 OLMo-2-1B 加装共享循环块，并在不同的循环深度下继续进行中期训练。在四遍模型中，额外的遍数主要是在一遍推理后已排名靠前的词元之间重新分配概率。我们利用在更大深度下生成的续写内容，仅通过单遍推理来训练共享块，且无需参考答案或正确性过滤。我们将这种转移方式称为“偏好回写”。偏好回写进一步提升了模型在大多数任务上的单遍和多遍准确率。在各自的目标深度下，更新后的模型优于参数量相当的非循环对照模型。
tldr: 本文提出“偏好回写”方法，利用循环语言模型在更大深度下自身生成的预测来训练共享块（无需参考答案），从而将深层计算带来的偏好内化到单遍推理中，同时提升单遍与多遍推理的准确率。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes "preference write-back," which trains a looped language model's shared block on its own deeper-pass predictions without reference answers, internalizing depth-induced preferences to improve both one-pass and multi-pass accuracy.
